window-1.title: River — a visual connection engine
window-1.blurb: It's an image-drift toy where every picture pulls you sideways into the next one — put on the "find Ancient Ceramics" or "Cool Sword" challenge and you'll surface twenty minutes later with a whole moodboard you didn't know you were building.

window-2.title: Colossal
window-2.blurb: It's a daily drip of people who went way too far on a handmade idea — thread portraits, stop-motion obsessives, clay worlds — and you'll come away with three new side quests before lunch.

window-3.title: Salted Plum Soda (and a Salted Plum Americano)
window-3.blurb: It turns those jarred salted plums from the Asian provision shop into a fizzy, salty-sour soda — and then dares you to pour it over espresso, which is exactly the kind of committed-to-the-bit move you'd pull at your own dinner party.

window-4.title: Inside Jen Mankins' Scandi-Inspired Brooklyn Brownstone, Redone
window-4.blurb: This one's the home of the woman who built Brooklyn's coolest indie boutique, so every corner has that shop-owner's eye — collected, warm, zero showroom energy — and I think you'll steal at least three ideas from the small details.

window-5.title: Toriei, Cuppage Plaza
window-5.blurb: A brand-new ten-seat yakitori counter buried on the fourth floor of Cuppage Plaza's gloriously time-warped 80s maze — the kind of place you have to hunt for, then smugly tell everyone about.
